---

## Symptom

What does the agent do wrong? Be specific about the observable behavior.

## Root Cause

Why does this happen? What misconception or default behavior causes it?

## Correct Approach

What should the agent do instead? Include the exact command or pattern.

## What to Avoid

What makes this worse or causes the agent to repeat the mistake?

## Evidence

How many sessions have you seen this in? Link to examples if possible.
